messages:
tara: Heads-up: noticed a subtle regression in quota-quarantine behavior. When route_by_cost spikes, some tenants get quarantined but console shows quota hit, not quarantine. Customers see degraded routing but SREs get confused.
omar: Can you paste an example? apply id or logs?
tara: logs: `quarantine: tenant=acct-504 thresh=0.06 cost_spike=1.8 action=quarantine_v2 applied_by=runtime` then console shows `quota_exceeded` in the incident stream instead of `quarantine_active`.
dev-bot: alert: quarantine-trigger acct-504 at 2026-06-10T02:11:22Z (rule=cost-spike-quarantine_v2)
ryn: sounds like a schema mismatch between runtime event tags and console parsers. Runtime emits `quarantine_v2` but Console maps only `quarantine` -> rule.
clare: UX ask: we should show an "impact preview" before quarantine runs (like a dry-run) that estimates routing delta, token-cost delta, and affected tenants. Operators could opt to "simulate -> apply" or allow auto-apply.
omar: proposal: add runtime config block `quarantine_policy` with fields: `enabled`, `cost_delta_threshold`, `impact_preview_window_ms`, `auto_apply=false`. Example: `{ "policy":"cost_quarantine_v2","cost_delta_threshold":0.05,"preview_window_ms":600000,"auto_apply":false }`.
tara: also want a console section: Config -> Quarantine Preview. When enabled it will show a ranked list of tenants that would be quarantined and the estimated reroute QPS + cost delta. This helps CS teams understand customer visibility.
dev-bot: suggestion logged: add-mapping quarantine_event_tag -> quarantine UI (id=cfg-7731)
ryn: telemetry requirement: when preview runs, capture both `preview.metrics` and `apply.metrics`. Preview should not consume quotas or change routing. Implement preview by running evaluation in worker with virtual meters and shadow telemetry (tagged `preview_id`).
clare: safety controls: (A) require `canary_pct` on auto-apply; (B) add a backoff window where once tenant is unquarantined it cannot be re-quarantined for X minutes to avoid flapping.
omar: good call. Implementation sketch: runtime exposes `POST /admin/quarantine/preview` returning `preview_id` and summary; `POST /admin/quarantine/apply?preview_id=...&canary=5` will apply to canary fraction. Also `POST /admin/quarantine/unquarantine?tenant=...` to force revert.
tara: alerting: if actual quarantine-induced fallback_rate increases > 0.25% above baseline for 2m, auto-pause `auto_apply` and notify #eng-oncall. Console should surface a single-click "pause auto-apply" toggle.
dev-bot: runbook stub created: "Quarantine preview -> apply -> abort" (link: https://runbooks.local/q/7731)
ryn: security note: quarantine rules often reference allocation keys and may include secret-like tokens for partner tenants; previews must redact secrets in outputs.
clare: acceptance criteria: (1) preview API that doesn't touch metrics/quota, (2) console UI with ranked tenant table, (3) canary apply path + auto-pause on threshold, (4) backoff window config and visible in tenant timeline.
omar: ETA: runtime preview worker + virtual-metering 3d, API + pause endpoints 1d, Console UI + alerts 2d. I'll open umbrella ticket.
tara: I'll coordinate SRE runbook and CS communication templates for tenants that see quarantines.
clare: small example preview response (for docs): ```json
{ "preview_id":"pv-20260610-01","would_quarantine": ["acct-504","acct-882"], "est_reroute_qps": 12.3, "est_cost_delta_pct": 4.2}
```
ryn: I'll add telemetry mapping and ensure preview metrics go to a separate topic `quarantine.preview.v1`.
dev-bot: ticket created: INF-2751 "quarantine preview + safe apply" (link: https://tracks.local/INF-2751)
tara: great. this should make quarantine actions transparent and avoid surprise customer cost bumps. :white_check_mark:
